name: superskillret
description: Embedding-based skill retrieval for Claude Code. On every user prompt, picks the top-K relevant skills from a 16,783-skill pool and injects them as context. v0.2.6: extracted daemon connection helpers into scripts/daemon_client.py so /superskillret:list and /superskillret:remove also lazy-spawn the daemon (previously only /add did, leaving list/remove stuck on 'daemon unreachable'). v0.2.5: per-session dedup default OFF + retrieved-vs-used self-report. v0.2.4 daemon lazy-spawn for /add; v0.2.3 empty-args fix; v0.2.2 PLUGIN_ROOT + bare-name + skip-dup; v0.2.1 lazy install; v0.2.0 custom skill registration.
